methods.name: Multi-bitemporal images (MBTIs)
methods.summary: A framework implemented in Google Earth Engine that collects all possible bi-temporal image pairs before and after a triggering event, calculates the difference in Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (DNDVI), and applies a reproducibility threshold to filter false positives and identify accumulated landslide impact areas.
methods.verbatim: The corresponding author, Yu-En Yang, can provide the data supporting the findings of this study upon reasonable request. https://drive.google.com/open?id=1xOn1uG8pcsnv5m_YeMy_jaJIdft8bvzk&usp=drive_fs.
